children: L&T Finance increased its net profit 33 per cent to ₹968 crore as costs were under control in the quarter-ended September 30, 2026, as against ₹727.71 crore in the year-ago period. Sequentially, the NBFC increased profit by over 8 per cent.

The net interest income (NII) increased 32.6 per cent to 3187.36 crore in the reporting quarter, as against ₹2,403 crore in the year ago period. On a quarter-on-quarter basis, the NII increased about 9 per cent.
The gross disbursals increased 27 per cent to ₹24,027 crore on a year-on-year basis but stayed flat sequentially.

The moderation in the over the previous quarter came on top of a decline in lending to farmers and rural business finance. Farmer finance dipped 1 per cent to ₹1,643 crore on a year-on-year basis and was down 33 per cent from the Q1FY27 number of ₹2,453 crore. The pattern was the same, albeit less severe, in rural business finance, with a marginal 1 per cent growth in lending to ₹6,356 crore compared with the corresponding quarter last fiscal and a 9% dip from last quarter.

“We tempered the disbursements in rural business finance as well as farm equipment finance because there was this huge monsoon-related overhang in July and August, so we obviously decided it was prudent for us not to fire our rural distribution much. So we have ensured that the growth comes from gold, which is a completely secured asset, and SME finance,” said Sudipto Ray, CEO of L&T Finance.
The NBFC’s net interst margin and fees increased about 20 basis points to 10.48 per cent in the recently concluded quarter, as against the 10.2 per cent in the year ago period.

The gross stage three delinquency assets as a share of gross disbursements reduced to 2.53 per cent in Q2 FY27 as against 3.29% in the year ago period. Net stage 3 was too reduced to 0.85 per cent from 1 per cent, reflecting better asset quality.

“Our disbursements have been relatively robust for the past couple of quarters,” said Ray. “Our OPEX also has been under control, in spite of the very fast build-out of the gold loan branches,” he added.

title: L&T Finance PAT up 33% on cost-efficiency in Q2FY27
